dimensions.evidenceA: Numbers describes those who died by the plague.
dimensions.evidenceB: Paul specifies those who fell in one day.
dimensions.label: Scope stated

evidence.observation: Numbers states that twenty-four thousand died by the plague.
Paul says that twenty-three thousand fell in one day after sexual immorality.

record.tension: The two sources state different numbers while also describing their scope differently.
record.title: How many fell in the plague?
